from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
a = [10, 15]  # annual production of fighter jets for year 1 and year 2
pilots_per_jet = 5  # each training jet trains 5 pilots per year
n_years = 2

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: number of training jets allocated in each year (INTEGER)
x = [m.addVar(v=f"x_{j}", lb=0, ub=a[j], vtype="I") for j in range(n_years)]

# Objective: maximize total trained pilots by end of year 2
m.setObjective(quicksum(pilots_per_jet * x[j] for j in range(n_years)), "maximize")

# Constraints: training jets cannot exceed annual production
for j in range(n_years):
    m.addCons(x[j] <= a[j], name=f"prod_limit_y{j+1}")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
months = range(1, 7)
demand = {1: 20000, 2: 40000, 3: 42000, 4: 35000, 5: 19000, 6: 18500}
init_workforce = 1000
init_inventory = 15000
sales_price = 300
raw_material_cost = 90
outsourcing_cost = 200
inventory_holding_cost = 15
backorder_cost = 35
labor_hours_per_unit = 5
regular_hours_per_worker = 160
regular_wage = 30
max_overtime_per_worker = 20
overtime_wage = 40
hiring_cost = 5000
firing_cost = 8000
terminal_inventory_min = 10000

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
P = {}  # in-house production (continuous)
O = {}  # outsourcing quantity (continuous)
W = {}  # workforce at end of month (integer)
H = {}  # workers hired (integer)
F = {}  # workers fired (integer)
I = {}  # inventory at end of month (continuous)
B = {}  # backorders at end of month (continuous)
OT = {}  # total overtime hours (continuous)

for t in months:
    P[t] = m.addVar(name=f"P_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    O[t] = m.addVar(name=f"O_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    W[t] = m.addVar(name=f"W_{t}", lb=0, vtype="I")
    H[t] = m.addVar(name=f"H_{t}", lb=0, vtype="I")
    F[t] = m.addVar(name=f"F_{t}", lb=0, vtype="I")
    I[t] = m.addVar(name=f"I_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    B[t] = m.addVar(name=f"B_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    OT[t] = m.addVar(name=f"OT_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")

# Constraints
for t in months:
    # Workforce balance
    if t == 1:
        m.addCons(W[t] == init_workforce + H[t] - F[t], name=f"workforce_{t}")
    else:
        m.addCons(W[t] == W[t-1] + H[t] - F[t], name=f"workforce_{t}")

    # Production capacity: P_t * 5 <= W_t * 160 + OT_t
    m.addCons(P[t] * labor_hours_per_unit <= W[t] * regular_hours_per_worker + OT[t], name=f"capacity_{t}")

    # Overtime limit: OT_t <= W_t * 20
    m.addCons(OT[t] <= W[t] * max_overtime_per_worker, name=f"overtime_limit_{t}")

    # Inventory balance: I_t - B_t = (I_{t-1} - B_{t-1}) + P_t + O_t - D_t
    if t == 1:
        m.addCons(I[t] - B[t] == init_inventory + P[t] + O[t] - demand[t], name=f"inventory_{t}")
    else:
        m.addCons(I[t] - B[t] == I[t-1] - B[t-1] + P[t] + O[t] - demand[t], name=f"inventory_{t}")

# Terminal conditions
m.addCons(I[6] >= terminal_inventory_min, name="terminal_inventory")
m.addCons(B[6] == 0, name="terminal_backorders")

# Objective: maximize profit = revenue - costs
# Revenue is constant since all demand is fulfilled (B_6 = 0)
revenue = sales_price * quicksum(demand[t] for t in months)

costs = (
    raw_material_cost * quicksum(P[t] for t in months)
    + outsourcing_cost * quicksum(O[t] for t in months)
    + inventory_holding_cost * quicksum(I[t] for t in months)
    + backorder_cost * quicksum(B[t] for t in months)
    + regular_wage * regular_hours_per_worker * quicksum(W[t] for t in months)
    + overtime_wage * quicksum(OT[t] for t in months)
    + hiring_cost * quicksum(H[t] for t in months)
    + firing_cost * quicksum(F[t] for t in months)
)

m.setObjective(revenue - costs, "maximize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
months = range(1, 7)
demand = {1: 20000, 2: 40000, 3: 42000, 4: 35000, 5: 19000, 6: 18500}
init_workforce = 1000
init_inventory = 15000
sales_price = 300
raw_material_cost = 90
outsourcing_cost = 200
inventory_holding_cost = 15
backorder_cost = 35
labor_hours_per_unit = 5
regular_hours_per_worker = 160
regular_wage = 30
max_overtime_per_worker = 20
overtime_wage = 40
hiring_cost = 5000
firing_cost = 8000
terminal_inventory_min = 10000

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
P = {}  # in-house production (continuous)
O = {}  # outsourcing quantity (continuous)
W = {}  # workforce at end of month (integer)
H = {}  # workers hired (integer)
F = {}  # workers fired (integer)
I = {}  # inventory at end of month (continuous)
B = {}  # backorders at end of month (continuous)
OT = {}  # total overtime hours (continuous)

for t in months:
    P[t] = m.addVar(name=f"P_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    O[t] = m.addVar(name=f"O_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    W[t] = m.addVar(name=f"W_{t}", lb=0, vtype="I")
    H[t] = m.addVar(name=f"H_{t}", lb=0, vtype="I")
    F[t] = m.addVar(name=f"F_{t}", lb=0, vtype="I")
    I[t] = m.addVar(name=f"I_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    B[t] = m.addVar(name=f"B_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")
    OT[t] = m.addVar(name=f"OT_{t}", lb=0, vtype="C")

# Constraints
for t in months:
    # Workforce balance
    if t == 1:
        m.addCons(W[t] == init_workforce + H[t] - F[t], name=f"workforce_{t}")
    else:
        m.addCons(W[t] == W[t-1] + H[t] - F[t], name=f"workforce_{t}")

    # Production capacity: P_t * 5 <= W_t * 160 + OT_t
    m.addCons(P[t] * labor_hours_per_unit <= W[t] * regular_hours_per_worker + OT[t], name=f"capacity_{t}")

    # Overtime limit: OT_t <= W_t * 20
    m.addCons(OT[t] <= W[t] * max_overtime_per_worker, name=f"overtime_limit_{t}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
warehouses = ["Verona", "Perugia", "Rome", "Pescara", "Taranto", "Lamezia"]
ports = ["Genoa", "Venice", "Ancona", "Naples", "Bari"]

supply = [10, 12, 20, 24, 18, 40]
demand = [20, 15, 25, 33, 21]

distances = [
    [290, 115, 355, 715, 810],    # Verona
    [380, 340, 165, 380, 610],    # Perugia
    [505, 530, 285, 220, 450],    # Rome
    [655, 450, 155, 240, 315],    # Pescara
    [1010, 840, 550, 305, 95],    # Taranto
    [1072, 1097, 747, 372, 333],  # Lamezia
]

rate = 30  # euros per km per container

n_wh = len(warehouses)
n_port = len(ports)

# Cost per container from warehouse i to port j
cost = [[rate * distances[i][j] for j in range(n_port)] for i in range(n_wh)]

# Model
m = Model("Transportation")
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x[i][j] = number of containers from warehouse i to port j
x = {}
for i in range(n_wh):
    for j in range(n_port):
        x[i, j] = m.addVar(name=f"x_{i}_{j}", lb=0.0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")

# Objective: minimize total transportation cost
m.setObjective(quicksum(cost[i][j] * x[i, j] for i in range(n_wh) for j in range(n_port)), "minimize")

# Supply constraints: total shipped from each warehouse <= available containers
for i in range(n_wh):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n_port)) <= supply[i], name=f"supply_{i}")

# Demand constraints: total received at each port = demand
for j in range(n_port):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(n_wh)) == demand[j], name=f"demand_{j}")

# Solve
m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for i in range(n_wh):
        for j in range(n_port):
            val = m.getVal(x[i, j])
            if val > 1e-6:
                print(f"  {warehouses[i]} -> {ports[j]}: {val:.4f} containers")

A = m.addVar("A", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=M_airplane)
B = m.addVar("B", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=M_boat)

yA = m.addVar("yA", vtype="B")
yB = m.addVar("yB", vtype="B")
yR = m.addVar("yR", vtype="B")

# Data: for each area, list of areas within 800m radius (i.e., if store built here, these areas are covered)
coverage = {
    'A': ['A', 'C', 'E', 'G', 'H', 'I'],
    'B': ['B', 'H', 'I'],
    'C': ['A', 'C', 'G', 'H', 'I'],
    'D': ['D', 'J'],
    'E': ['A', 'E', 'G'],
    'F': ['F', 'J', 'K'],
    'G': ['A', 'C', 'E', 'G'],
    'H': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'H', 'I'],
    'I': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'H', 'I'],
    'J': ['D', 'F', 'J', 'K', 'L'],
    'K': ['F', 'J', 'K', 'L'],
    'L': ['J', 'K', 'L'],
}

areas = list(coverage.keys())

# For each area Y, find which store locations X can cover Y (Y appears in X's coverage list)
can_cover = {y: [x for x in areas if y in coverage[x]] for y in areas}

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: binary, 1 if a store is built at area i
x = {a: m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{a}") for a in areas}

# Objective: minimize total number of stores
m.setObjective(quicksum(x[a] for a in areas), "minimize")

# Coverage constraints: each area must be within 800m of at least one store
for y in areas:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[xc] for xc in can_cover[y]) >= 1, name=f"cover_{y}")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for a in areas:
        if m.getVal(x[a]) > 0.5:
            print(f"Store at: {a}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data transcribed from Table 5-11
n = 6
volumes = [1500, 2500, 4000, 6000, 9000, 12000]
demands = [500, 550, 700, 900, 400, 300]
var_costs = [5, 8, 10, 12, 16, 18]
setup_cost = 1200
M = sum(demands)  # Big-M for linking constraints

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# x[i]: production quantity of container type i (continuous, non-negative)
# y[i]: binary, 1 if equipment for type i is activated
x = [m.addVar(v=f"x_{i}", lb=0, ub=M, vtype="C") for i in range(n)]
y = [m.addVar(v=f"y_{i}", lb=0, ub=1, vtype="B") for i in range(n)]

# Objective: minimize total variable production cost + fixed setup cost
obj = quicksum(var_costs[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) + quicksum(setup_cost * y[i] for i in range(n))
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution:
# For type i, any type j with j >= i (volume[j] >= volume[i]) can substitute
# so sum of production of types i..n-1 must meet demand[i]
for i in range(n):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[j] for j in range(i, n)) >= demands[i], name=f"demand_{i}")

# Linking constraints: production only if equipment is activated
for i in range(n):
    m.addCons(x[i] <= M * y[i], name=f"link_{i}")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

x_wheat = m.addVar("x_wheat", lb=0, vtype="C")

x_sorghum = m.addVar("x_sorghum", lb=0, vtype="C")

)

}

min_veg_types = 3
pack_size = 100  # grams per pack/unit

m = Model()

    x[p] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0.0, name=f"x_{p}")

for v in vegetables:
    x[v] = m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0.0, name=f"x_{v}")

y = {}

    y[v] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"y_{v}")

M = int(max_weight_grams / pack_size)  # 8

m.addCons(
    quicksum(proteins[p]['cost'] * x[p] for p in proteins) +
    quicksum(vegetables[v]['cost'] * x[v] for v in vegetables)
    <= budget,
    name="budget"
)

    quicksum(x[p] for p in proteins) +

    name="weight"
)

    quicksum(y[v] for v in vegetables) >= min_veg_types,
    name="min_veg_types"
)

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
n = 10
r = [3, 5, 2, 4, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]  # 1-indexed: r[j] for stage j
a = 10  # cost of buying a new tool
b = 1   # cost of slow repair
c = 3   # cost of fast repair
p = 3   # slow repair duration (stages)
q = 1   # fast repair duration (stages)

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables (1-indexed stages)
# x[j]: new tools purchased at stage j
# s[j]: tools sent for slow repair after stage j
# f[j]: tools sent for fast repair after stage j
x = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"x_{j}") for j in range(1, n + 1)]
s = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"s_{j}") for j in range(1, n + 1)]
f = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"f_{j}") for j in range(1, n + 1)]

# Constraints:
# 1) All tools used at stage j are sent for repair: s[j] + f[j] = r[j]
for j in range(1, n + 1):

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
months = [1, 2, 3]
buy_price = {1: 8, 2: 6, 3: 9}
sell_price = {1: 9, 2: 8, 3: 10}
initial_stock = 200
capacity = 500

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = {}  # units purchased in month i
s = {}  # units sold in month i
w = {}  # end-of-month inventory

for i in months:
    x[i] = m.addVar(name=f"x_{i}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
    s[i] = m.addVar(name=f"s_{i}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
    w[i] = m.addVar(name=f"w_{i}", lb=0, ub=capacity, vtype="C")

# Inventory balance constraints
# w[i] = w[i-1] + x[i] - s[i], with w[0] = initial_stock
m.addCons(w[1] == initial_stock + x[1] - s[1], name="bal_1")
m.addCons(w[2] == w[1] + x[2] - s[2], name="bal_2")
m.addCons(w[3] == w[2] + x[3] - s[3], name="bal_3")

# Objective: maximize total profit
obj = quicksum(sell_price[i] * s[i] - buy_price[i] * x[i] for i in months)
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for i in months:
        print(f"Month {i}: buy={m.getVal(x[i])}, sell={m.getVal(s[i])}, end_stock={m.getVal(w[i])}")

for l1 in range(13):

        for l3 in range(13 - l1 - l2):
            for l4 in range(13 - l1 - l2 - l3):

B = m.addVar("B", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=60)   # building blocks

y_C = m.addVar("y_C", vtype="B")

y_D = m.addVar("y_D", vtype="B")

m.addCons(R <= 40 * y_R)
m.addCons(C <= 120 * y_C)
m.addCons(B <= 60 * y_B)
m.addCons(D <= 80 * y_D)

# Constraint: Electronic components (800 units)
m.addCons(8*R + 5*C + 3*B + 2*D <= 800)

m.addCons(y_R + y_D <= 1)

m.addCons(D <= C)

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# --- DATA (transcribed once from problem text) ---
PROFITS = {"robot": 15, "model_car": 8, "building_blocks": 12, "doll": 5}
PLASTIC_AVAIL = 1200
PLASTIC_USE = {"robot": 30, "model_car": 10, "building_blocks": 20, "doll": 15}
ELEC_AVAIL = 800
ELEC_USE = {"robot": 8, "model_car": 5, "building_blocks": 3, "doll": 2}

# Big-M upper bounds derived from plastic availability
UB_R = PLASTIC_AVAIL // PLASTIC_USE["robot"]      # 40
UB_C = PLASTIC_AVAIL // PLASTIC_USE["model_car"]  # 120
UB_B = PLASTIC_AVAIL // PLASTIC_USE["building_blocks"]  # 60
UB_D = PLASTIC_AVAIL // PLASTIC_USE["doll"]       # 80

# --- MODEL ---
m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: integer counts
R = m.addVar("R", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=UB_R)
C = m.addVar("C", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=UB_C)
B = m.addVar("B", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=UB_B)
D = m.addVar("D", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=UB_D)

# Binary indicators: 1 if that toy type is manufactured
yR = m.addVar("yR", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)
yC = m.addVar("yC", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)
yB = m.addVar("yB", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)
yD = m.addVar("yD", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)

# Linking: production > 0 implies indicator = 1
m.addCons(R <= UB_R * yR)
m.addCons(C <= UB_C * yC)
m.addCons(B <= UB_B * yB)
m.addCons(D <= UB_D * yD)

# Resource: plastic
m.addCons(PLASTIC_USE["robot"] * R + PLASTIC_USE["model_car"] * C + PLASTIC_USE["building_blocks"] * B + PLASTIC_USE["doll"] * D <= PLASTIC_AVAIL)

# Resource: electronic components
m.addCons(ELEC_USE["robot"] * R + ELEC_USE["model_car"] * C + ELEC_USE["building_blocks"] * B + ELEC_USE["doll"] * D <= ELEC_AVAIL)

# If robots manufactured, no dolls
m.addCons(yR + yD <= 1)

# If model cars manufactured, building blocks also manufactured
m.addCons(yC <= yB)

# Dolls <= model cars
m.addCons(D <= C)

# Objective: maximize total profit
obj = quicksum([PROFITS["robot"] * R,
                PROFITS["model_car"] * C,
                PROFITS["building_blocks"] * B,
                PROFITS["doll"] * D])
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

# --- SOLVE ---
m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    print(f"robots: {m.getVal(R)}")
    print(f"model_cars: {m.getVal(C)}")
    print(f"building_blocks: {m.getVal(B)}")

y_B = m.addVar("y_B", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)

)

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
products = ['A1', 'A2', 'A3']
n = 3
max_demand = [5300, 4500, 5400]
price = [124, 109, 115]
prod_cost = [73.30, 52.90, 65.40]
quota = [500, 450, 550]
activation_cost = [170000, 150000, 100000]
min_batch = [20, 20, 16]
days = 22

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = [m.addVar(v=f"x_{i}", lb=0, ub=max_demand[i], vtype="C") for i in range(n)]
y = [m.addVar(v=f"y_{i}", lb=0, ub=1, vtype="B") for i in range(n)]

# Demand constraints
for i in range(n):
    m.addCons(x[i] <= max_demand[i], f"demand_{i}")

# Production capacity: x_i / quota_i days used, total <= 22
m.addCons(quicksum(x[i] / quota[i] for i in range(n)) <= days, "capacity")

# Minimum batch: x_i >= min_batch_i * y_i
for i in range(n):
    m.addCons(x[i] >= min_batch[i] * y[i], f"minbatch_{i}")

# Link: x_i <= max_demand_i * y_i
for i in range(n):
    m.addCons(x[i] <= max_demand[i] * y[i], f"link_{i}")

# Objective: maximize profit = (price - cost)*x - activation*y
obj = quicksum((price[i] - prod_cost[i]) * x[i] for i in range(n)) - quicksum(activation_cost[i] * y[i] for i in range(n))
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for i in range(n):
        print(f"{products[i]}: x={m.getVal(x[i])}, y={m.getVal(y[i])}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# --- DATA ---
BUDGET = 100000
R1 = 0.7   # Option 1: return per yuan after 1 year (total payout = 1.7 per yuan)
R2 = 2.0   # Option 2: return per yuan after 2 years (total payout = 3.0 per yuan)

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# --- DECISION VARIABLES (all continuous, non-negative) ---
x1 = m.addVar("x1", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Opt1 at year 0 -> matures year 1
x2 = m.addVar("x2", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Opt2 at year 0 -> matures year 2
a1 = m.addVar("a1", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Opt1 at year 1 -> matures year 2
a2 = m.addVar("a2", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Opt2 at year 1 -> matures year 3
b1 = m.addVar("b1", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Opt1 at year 2 -> matures year 3
# Note: Cannot invest in Opt2 at year 2 (needs 2 yrs, only 1 remains)

# --- CONSTRAINTS ---
# Year 0: total investment cannot exceed budget
m.addCons(x1 + x2 <= BUDGET, "budget_year0")

# Year 1: reinvest from Opt1 proceeds (x1 matures)
m.addCons(a1 + a2 <= (1.0 + R1) * x1, "budget_year1")

# Year 2: reinvest from Opt1(a1) + Opt2(x2) proceeds; only Opt1 available
m.addCons(b1 <= (1.0 + R1) * a1 + (1.0 + R2) * x2, "budget_year2")

# --- OBJECTIVE: maximize total wealth at end of year 3 ---
# b1 matures via Opt1: (1+R1)*b1
# a2 matures via Opt2: (1+R2)*a2
obj = (1.0 + R1) * b1 + (1.0 + R2) * a2
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
requirements = [10, 15, 25, 20, 18, 12]
n_periods = 6

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x[i] = number of salespeople starting shift at period i
x = [m.addVar(v=f"x_{i}", lb=0, vtype="I") for i in range(n_periods)]

# Constraints: each period must be covered by the shift starting there and the one starting in the previous period
# Period i is covered by x[i] (starts at period i) and x[i-1] (starts at period i-1, works 8h = 2 periods)
for i in range(n_periods):
    prev = (i - 1) % n_periods
    m.addCons(x[i] + x[prev] >= requirements[i], name=f"cover_{i}")

# Objective: minimize total salespeople
m.setObjective(quicksum(x), "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for i in range(n_periods):
        print(f"  x_{i} = {m.getVal(x[i])}")

FUND = 300000

P2_LIMIT = 150000
P3_RATE = 0.60       # Project 3 total return multiplier (160%)
P3_LIMIT = 200000
P4_RATE = 0.40       # Project 4 profit rate (140% total)
P4_LIMIT = 100000

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables (all continuous, >= 0)
x1 = m.addVar("x1", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Project 1, beginning of Year 1
x2 = m.addVar("x2", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Project 2, beginning of Year 1
x3 = m.addVar("x3", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Project 1, beginning of Year 2
x4 = m.addVar("x4", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Project 3, beginning of Year 2
x5 = m.addVar("x5", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Project 1, beginning of Year 3
x6 = m.addVar("x6", lb=0, vtype="C")  # Project 4, beginning of Year 3

# Constraints
# Year 1 budget: invest in Project 1 + Project 2
m.addCons(x1 + x2 <= FUND, "year1_budget")

# Year 2 budget: returns from Project 1 Year 1
m.addCons(x3 + x4 <= 1.2 * x1, "year2_budget")

# Year 3 budget: returns from Project 1 Year 2 + Project 2
m.addCons(x5 + x6 <= 1.2 * x3 + 1.5 * x2, "year3_budget")

# Investment limits
m.addCons(x2 <= P2_LIMIT, "p2_limit")
m.addCons(x4 <= P3_LIMIT, "p3_limit")
m.addCons(x6 <= P4_LIMIT, "p4_limit")

# Objective: maximize total principal + interest at end of Year 3
# Project 1 Year 3 returns 120%, Project 3 returns 160%, Project 4 returns 140%
obj = 1.2 * x5 + 1.6 * x4 + 1.4 * x6
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

                x[(i, j, k)] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, ub=N_types[i], name=f"x_{i}_{j}_{k}")

# Demand deviation variables
d_minus = {}
d_plus = {}
for j in range(2):
    for k in range(3):
        d_minus[(j, k)] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name=f"dm_{j}_{k}")
        d_plus[(j, k)] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name=f"dp_{j}_{k}")

# P2 and P3 deviation variables

d2_plus = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name="d2_plus")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
workshops = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']
components = [1, 2, 3]

capacity = {'A': 100, 'B': 150, 'C': 80, 'D': 200}

# rate[i][j] = units of component j produced per hour by workshop i
rate = {
    'A': {1: 10, 2: 15, 3: 5},
    'B': {1: 15, 2: 10, 3: 5},
    'C': {1: 20, 2: 5, 3: 10},
    'D': {1: 10, 2: 15, 3: 20},
}

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# x[i][j]: hours workshop i allocates to component j (continuous, >= 0)
x = {}
for i in workshops:
    for j in components:
        x[i][j] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0.0, name=f"x_{i}_{j}")

# P: number of completed products (continuous, >= 0)
P = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0.0, name="P")

# Constraints: workshop capacity
for i in workshops:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i][j] for j in components) <= capacity[i], name=f"cap_{i}")

# Constraints: component production must meet P
for j in components:
    m.addCons(quicksum(rate[i][j] * x[i][j] for i in workshops) >= P, name=f"prod_comp_{j}")

# Objective: maximize P
m.setObjective(P, "maximize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data: item values (dogs grouped as one item since they must not be separated)
items = {
    "painting_caillebotte": 25000,
    "bust_diocletian": 5000,
    "yuan_vase": 20000,
    "porsche_911": 40000,
    "diamond_1": 12000,
    "diamond_2": 12000,
    "diamond_3": 12000,
    "sofa_louis_xv": 3000,
    "two_dogs": 6000,       # 2 dogs at $3000 each, must stay together
    "sculpture_200ad": 10000,
    "sailing_boat": 15000,
    "harley_davidson": 10000,
    "furniture_cavour": 13000,
}

total_value = sum(items.values())  # 183000

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x[i] = 1 if item i goes to son 1, 0 if son 2
x = {i: m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{i}") for i in items}

# d: the absolute difference in value between the two sons
d = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name="d")

# Objective: minimize the difference
m.setObjective(d, "minimize")

# Constraints to linearize |2*sum(v_i*x_i) - total|
# d >= 2*sum(v_i*x_i) - total
m.addCons(d >= 2 * quicksum(items[i] * x[i] for i in items) - total_value)
# d >= total - 2*sum(v_i*x_i)
m.addCons(d >= total_value - 2 * quicksum(items[i] * x[i] for i in items))

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    print(f"\nSon 1 receives:")
    val1 = 0
    for i in items:
        if m.getVal(x[i]) > 0.5:
            print(f"  {i}: ${items[i]}")
            val1 += items[i]
    print(f"  Total: ${val1}")
    print(f"\nSon 2 receives: ${total_value - val1}")
    print(f"Difference: ${m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data transcribed from problem
goods = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']
quantities = {'A': 120, 'B': 90, 'C': 300, 'D': 90, 'E': 120}
weights = {'A': 0.5, 'B': 1.0, 'C': 0.4, 'D': 0.6, 'E': 0.65}
max_weight = 60   # tons per container
min_weight = 18   # tons per container
min_D = 12        # units of D per container
N = 10            # upper bound on number of containers

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# x[i][j] = number of units of good i loaded in container j (integer)
x = {}
for i in goods:
    for j in range(N):
        x[i][j] = m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"x_{i}_{j}")

# y[j] = 1 if container j is used (binary)
y = {}
for j in range(N):
    y[j] = m.addVar(vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1, name=f"y_{j}")

# Constraints
for j in range(N):
    # Max weight capacity: sum of weights <= 60 * y_j
    m.addCons(quicksum(weights[i] * x[i][j] for i in goods) <= max_weight * y[j], name=f"max_w_{j}")
    # Min load: sum of weights >= 18 * y_j
    m.addCons(quicksum(weights[i] * x[i][j] for i in goods) >= min_weight * y[j], name=f"min_w_{j}")
    # Each used container must have at least 12 units of D
    m.addCons(x['D'][j] >= min_D * y[j], name=f"min_D_{j}")
    # A-C coupling: if any A is loaded, at least 1 C must be loaded
    # Max A in one container by weight: 60/0.5 = 120
    m.addCons(x['A'][j] <= 120 * x['C'][j], name=f"AC_{j}")

# All units of each good must be packed
for i in goods:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i][j] for j in range(N)) == quantities[i], name=f"pack_{i}")

# Objective: minimize number of containers used
m.setObjective(quicksum(y[j] for j in range(N)), "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
n = 5  # number of jobs (batches)
m = 3  # number of machines (vats)
p = [
    [3, 1, 1],
    [2, 1.5, 1],
    [3, 1.2, 1.3],
    [2, 2, 2],
    [2.1, 2, 3]
]

M = 30  # Big-M (sum of all processing times is 28.1)

model = Model()
model.hideOutput()
model.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# S[i][j] = start time of job i on machine j
S = [[model.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name=f"S_{i}_{j}") for j in range(m)] for i in range(n)]

# x[i,k,j] = 1 if job i is scheduled before job k on machine j (i < k)
x = {}
for j in range(m):
    for i in range(n):
        for k in range(i + 1, n):
            x[i, k, j] = model.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{i}_{k}_{j}")

# Cmax = makespan
Cmax = model.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name="Cmax")

# Constraints
# 1. Flow-shop precedence: job i on machine j+1 starts after finishing on machine j
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(m - 1):
        model.addCons(S[i][j + 1] >= S[i][j] + p[i][j], name=f"prec_{i}_{j}")

# 2. Non-overlapping on each machine (disjunctive constraints)
for j in range(m):
    for i in range(n):
        for k in range(i + 1, n):
            # x=1 => i before k on machine j
            model.addCons(S[i][j] + p[i][j] <= S[k][j] + M * (1 - x[i, k, j]),
                          name=f"noov_{i}_{k}_{j}_a")
            # x=0 => k before i on machine j
            model.addCons(S[k][j] + p[k][j] <= S[i][j] + M * x[i, k, j],
                          name=f"noov_{i}_{k}_{j}_b")

# 3. Makespan: Cmax >= completion of every job on the last machine
for i in range(n):
    model.addCons(Cmax >= S[i][m - 1] + p[i][m - 1], name=f"cmax_{i}")

# Objective: minimize makespan
model.setObjective(Cmax, "minimize")

model.optimize()

st = model.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if model.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {model.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Data (Table 3.1)
# Process I: A=4 hrs/unit, B=6 hrs/unit, capacity=150
# Process II: A=3 hrs/unit, B=2 hrs/unit, capacity=70
# Profit: A=$300/unit, B=$450/unit
# Goals: p1: profit>=10000; p2: x_A>=10, x_B>=15; p3: ProcI=150, ProcII=70 (overtime ok)

# Decision variables (continuous, non-negative)
x_A = m.addVar("x_A", lb=0, vtype="C")
x_B = m.addVar("x_B", lb=0, vtype="C")

# Deviation variables for Goal 1: profit >= 10000
d1_minus = m.addVar("d1_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d1_plus = m.addVar("d1_plus", lb=0, vtype="C")

# Deviation variables for Goal 2: x_A >= 10, x_B >= 15
d2a_minus = m.addVar("d2a_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d2a_plus = m.addVar("d2a_plus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d2b_minus = m.addVar("d2b_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d2b_plus = m.addVar("d2b_plus", lb=0, vtype="C")

# Deviation variables for Goal 3: ProcI = 150, ProcII = 70
d3a_minus = m.addVar("d3a_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d3a_plus = m.addVar("d3a_plus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d3b_minus = m.addVar("d3b_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d3b_plus = m.addVar("d3b_plus", lb=0, vtype="C")

# Hard constraint: Process I capacity (cannot exceed 150 hours)
m.addCons(4 * x_A + 6 * x_B <= 150, "proc_I_capacity")

# Goal 1: 300*x_A + 450*x_B + d1^- - d1^+ = 10000
m.addCons(300 * x_A + 450 * x_B + d1_minus - d1_plus == 10000, "goal1_profit")

# Goal 2a: x_A + d2a^- - d2a^+ = 10
m.addCons(x_A + d2a_minus - d2a_plus == 10, "goal2a_minA")

# Goal 2b: x_B + d2b^- - d2b^+ = 15
m.addCons(x_B + d2b_minus - d2b_plus == 15, "goal2b_minB")

# Goal 3a: 4*x_A + 6*x_B + d3a^- - d3a^+ = 150
m.addCons(4 * x_A + 6 * x_B + d3a_minus - d3a_plus == 150, "goal3a_procI")

# Goal 3b: 3*x_A + 2*x_B + d3b^- - d3b^+ = 70
m.addCons(3 * x_A + 2 * x_B + d3b_minus - d3b_plus == 70, "goal3b_procII")

# Preemptive (lexicographic) goal programming objective using large weights
# Priority 1: minimize underachievement of profit target
# Priority 2: minimize underachievement of minimum production
# Priority 3: minimize deviation from full capacity (ProcI both sides, ProcII only underutilization)
M1 = 1000000
M2 = 10000
M3 = 1

obj = M1 * d1_minus + M2 * (d2a_minus + d2b_minus) + M3 * (d3a_minus + d3a_plus + d3b_minus)
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
pollution = {"motorcycle": 40, "small_truck": 70, "large_truck": 100}
capacity = {"motorcycle": 10, "small_truck": 20, "large_truck": 50}
max_motorcycle_trips = 8
min_products = 300
max_total_trips = 20
methods = ["motorcycle", "small_truck", "large_truck"]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = {}
for meth in methods:
    x[meth] = m.addVar(name=f"x_{meth}", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=m.infinity())

y = {}
for meth in methods:
    y[meth] = m.addVar(name=f"y_{meth}", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)

# Objective: minimize total pollution
m.setObjective(quicksum(pollution[meth] * x[meth] for meth in methods), "minimize")

# Constraint: choose exactly 2 out of 3 methods
m.addCons(quicksum(y[meth] for meth in methods) == 2, "choose_two")

# Constraint: motorcycle trips <= 8
m.addCons(x["motorcycle"] <= max_motorcycle_trips, "max_motorcycle")

# Constraint: transport at least 300 units
m.addCons(quicksum(capacity[meth] * x[meth] for meth in methods) >= min_products, "min_products")

# Constraint: total trips <= 20
m.addCons(quicksum(x[meth] for meth in methods) <= max_total_trips, "max_trips")

# Linking constraints: if method not chosen, trips = 0
m.addCons(x["motorcycle"] <= max_motorcycle_trips * y["motorcycle"], "link_moto")
m.addCons(x["small_truck"] <= max_total_trips * y["small_truck"], "link_small")
m.addCons(x["large_truck"] <= max_total_trips * y["large_truck"], "link_large")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

# Resources: tech=100hr, labor=700hr, mat=400kg

# B: [0,50]->6, (50,100]->4, (100,inf)->3
# C: [0,100]->5, (100,inf)->4

A1 = m.addVar("A1", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=40)
A2 = m.addVar("A2", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=60)
A3 = m.addVar("A3", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=50)
A4 = m.addVar("A4", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=M)

B1 = m.addVar("B1", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=50)
B2 = m.addVar("B2", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=50)
B3 = m.addVar("B3", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=M)

C1 = m.addVar("C1", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=100)
C2 = m.addVar("C2", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=M)

yA2 = m.addVar("yA2", vtype="B")
yA3 = m.addVar("yA3", vtype="B")
yA4 = m.addVar("yA4", vtype="B")
yB2 = m.addVar("yB2", vtype="B")
yB3 = m.addVar("yB3", vtype="B")
yC2 = m.addVar("yC2", vtype="B")

m.addCons(A2 >= 60 * yA3, "A2_full_if_A3")
m.addCons(A3 >= 50 * yA4, "A3_full_if_A4")
m.addCons(yA2 >= yA3, "A_order_23")
m.addCons(yA3 >= yA4, "A_order_34")

m.addCons(B1 >= 50 * yB2, "B1_full_if_B2")
m.addCons(B2 >= 50 * yB3, "B2_full_if_B3")
m.addCons(yB2 >= yB3, "B_order_23")

import json

# Data
wages = [10.0, 10.0, 9.9, 9.8, 10.8, 11.3]

    [6, 0, 6, 0, 7],   # Student 1
    [0, 8, 9, 6, 0],   # Student 2
    [4, 8, 3, 0, 5],   # Student 3
    [5, 5, 6, 0, 4],   # Student 4
    [3, 0, 5, 8, 0],   # Student 5
    [0, 6, 0, 6, 5],   # Student 6
]
n_students = 6
n_days = 5
lab_hours = 14
undergrad_min = 8
grad_min = 7
max_shifts_per_student = 2
max_students_per_day = 3
undergrads = [0, 1, 2, 3]  # 0-indexed
grads = [4, 5]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# x[i,d] = hours student i works on day d (continuous, >= 0)
x = {}
for i in range(n_students):
    for d in range(n_days):
        x[i, d] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0.0, ub=max_hours[i][d], name=f"x_{i}_{d}")

# y[i,d] = binary, 1 if student i works on day d
y = {}
for i in range(n_students):
    for d in range(n_days):
        y[i, d] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"y_{i}_{d}")

# Constraints

# 1. Coverage: exactly 14 hours covered each day (one student on duty at all times)
for d in range(n_days):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, d] for i in range(n_students)) == lab_hours, name=f"coverage_{d}")

# 2. Link x to y: x[i,d] <= max_hours[i,d] * y[i,d]
for i in range(n_students):
    for d in range(n_days):
        if max_hours[i][d] > 0:
            m.addCons(x[i, d] <= max_hours[i][d] * y[i, d], name=f"link_{i}_{d}")
        else:
            m.addCons(x[i, d] == 0, name=f"link_{i}_{d}")

# 3. Undergraduate minimum hours (students 1-4, 0-indexed 0-3)
for i in undergrads:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, d] for d in range(n_days)) >= undergrad_min, name=f"min_under_{i}")

# 4. Graduate minimum hours (students 5-6, 0-indexed 4-5)
for i in grads:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, d] for d in range(n_days)) >= grad_min, name=f"min_grad_{i}")

# 5. Max shifts per student (at most 2 days)
for i in range(n_students):
    m.addCons(quicksum(y[i, d] for d in range(n_days)) <= max_shifts_per_student, name=f"max_shifts_{i}")

# 6. Max students per day (at most 3)
for d in range(n_days):
    m.addCons(quicksum(y[i, d] for i in range(n_students)) <= max_students_per_day, name=f"max_per_day_{d}")

# Objective: minimize total gross pay
obj = quicksum(wages[i] * x[i, d] for i in range(n_students) for d in range(n_days))
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

m.optimize()

    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

# Data
wages = [10.0, 10.0, 9.9, 9.8, 10.8, 11.3]
max_hours = [
    [6, 0, 6, 0, 7],   # Student 1
    [0, 8, 9, 6, 0],   # Student 2
    [4, 8, 3, 0, 5],   # Student 3
    [5, 5, 6, 0, 4],   # Student 4
    [3, 0, 5, 8, 0],   # Student 5
    [0, 6, 0, 6, 5],   # Student 6
]
n_students = 6
n_days = 5
lab_hours = 14
undergrad_min = 8
grad_min = 7
max_shifts_per_student = 2
max_students_per_day = 3
undergrads = [0, 1, 2, 3]  # 0-indexed
grads = [4, 5]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# x[i,d] = hours student i works on day d (continuous, >= 0)
x = {}
for i in range(n_students):
    for d in range(n_days):
        x[i, d] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0.0, ub=max_hours[i][d], name=f"x_{i}_{d}")

# y[i,d] = binary, 1 if student i works on day d
y = {}
for i in range(n_students):
    for d in range(n_days):
        y[i, d] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"y_{i}_{d}")

# Constraints

# 1. Coverage: exactly 14 hours covered each day (one student on duty at all times)
for d in range(n_days):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, d] for i in range(n_students)) == lab_hours, name=f"coverage_{d}")

# 2. Link x to y: x[i,d] <= max_hours[i,d] * y[i,d]
for i in range(n_students):
    for d in range(n_days):
        if max_hours[i][d] > 0:
            m.addCons(x[i, d] <= max_hours[i][d] * y[i, d], name=f"link_{i}_{d}")
        else:
            m.addCons(x[i, d] == 0, name=f"link_{i}_{d}")

# 3. Undergraduate minimum hours (students 1-4, 0-indexed 0-3)
for i in undergrads:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, d] for d in range(n_days)) >= undergrad_min, name=f"min_under_{i}")

# 4. Graduate minimum hours (students 5-6, 0-indexed 4-5)
for i in grads:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, d] for d in range(n_days)) >= grad_min, name=f"min_grad_{i}")

# 5. Max shifts per student (at most 2 days)
for i in range(n_students):
    m.addCons(quicksum(y[i, d] for d in range(n_days)) <= max_shifts_per_student, name=f"max_shifts_{i}")

# 6. Max students per day (at most 3)
for d in range(n_days):
    m.addCons(quicksum(y[i, d] for i in range(n_students)) <= max_students_per_day, name=f"max_per_day_{d}")

# Objective: minimize total gross pay
obj = quicksum(wages[i] * x[i, d] for i in range(n_students) for d in range(n_days))
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
proc1_A = 4      # hours/unit for Model A, Process I
proc1_B = 6      # hours/unit for Model B, Process I
proc1_cap = 150  # max weekly capacity Process I

proc2_A = 3      # hours/unit for Model A, Process II
proc2_B = 2      # hours/unit for Model B, Process II
proc2_cap = 70   # max weekly regular capacity Process II
proc2_ot_max = 30  # max overtime Process II

profit_A = 300   # yuan/unit Model A
profit_B = 450   # yuan/unit Model B
ot_pen_A = 20    # profit reduction per unit A during overtime
ot_pen_B = 25    # profit reduction per unit B during overtime

goal1_profit = 10000  # p1: min profit
goal2_A = 10          # p2: min units A
goal2_B = 15          # p2: min units B

# Priority weights (lexicographic approximation)
W1 = 1000000
W2 = 10000
W3 = 1

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x_A_reg = m.addVar("x_A_reg", lb=0, vtype="C")
x_A_ot  = m.addVar("x_A_ot",  lb=0, vtype="C")
x_B_reg = m.addVar("x_B_reg", lb=0, vtype="C")
x_B_ot  = m.addVar("x_B_ot",  lb=0, vtype="C")

# Deviation variables
d1_minus = m.addVar("d1_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d1_plus  = m.addVar("d1_plus",  lb=0, vtype="C")

d2a_minus = m.addVar("d2a_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d2a_plus  = m.addVar("d2a_plus",  lb=0, vtype="C")
d2b_minus = m.addVar("d2b_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d2b_plus  = m.addVar("d2b_plus",  lb=0, vtype="C")

d3a_minus = m.addVar("d3a_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d3a_plus  = m.addVar("d3a_plus",  lb=0, vtype="C")
d3b_minus = m.addVar("d3b_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d3b_plus  = m.addVar("d3b_plus",  lb=0, vtype="C")
d3c_minus = m.addVar("d3c_minus", lb=0, vtype="C")
d3c_plus  = m.addVar("d3c_plus",  lb=0, vtype="C")

# Hard constraints
# Process I capacity
m.addCons(proc1_A * (x_A_reg + x_A_ot) + proc1_B * (x_B_reg + x_B_ot) <= proc1_cap, "proc1_cap")

# Process II regular capacity
m.addCons(proc2_A * x_A_reg + proc2_B * x_B_reg <= proc2_cap, "proc2_reg_cap")

# Process II max overtime
m.addCons(proc2_A * x_A_ot + proc2_B * x_B_ot <= proc2_ot_max, "proc2_ot_cap")

# Goal 1 (p1): Total profit >= 10000
# Profit = 300*x_A_reg + 450*x_B_reg + (300-20)*x_A_ot + (450-25)*x_B_ot
m.addCons(
    profit_A * x_A_reg + profit_B * x_B_reg
    + (profit_A - ot_pen_A) * x_A_ot + (profit_B - ot_pen_B) * x_B_ot
    + d1_minus - d1_plus == goal1_profit, "goal1"
)

# Goal 2 (p2): x_A >= 10, x_B >= 15
m.addCons(x_A_reg + x_A_ot + d2a_minus - d2a_plus == goal2_A, "goal2a")
m.addCons(x_B_reg + x_B_ot + d2b_minus - d2b_plus == goal2_B, "goal2b")

# Goal 3 (p3): Process I = 150, Process II regular = 70, overtime = 0
m.addCons(
    proc1_A * (x_A_reg + x_A_ot) + proc1_B * (x_B_reg + x_B_ot)
    + d3a_minus - d3a_plus == proc1_cap, "goal3a"
)
m.addCons(
    proc2_A * x_A_reg + proc2_B * x_B_reg
    + d3b_minus - d3b_plus == proc2_cap, "goal3b"
)
m.addCons(
    proc2_A * x_A_ot + proc2_B * x_B_ot
    + d3c_minus - d3c_plus == 0, "goal3c"
)

# Objective: lexicographic goal programming
obj = (
    W1 * d1_minus
    + W2 * (d2a_minus + d2b_minus)
    + W3 * (d3a_minus + d3a_plus + d3b_minus + d3b_plus + d3c_minus + d3c_plus)
)
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    print(f"x_A_reg = {m.getVal(x_A_reg)}")
    print(f"x_A_ot  = {m.getVal(x_A_ot)}")
    print(f"x_B_reg = {m.getVal(x_B_reg)}")
    print(f"x_B_ot  = {m.getVal(x_B_ot)}")

m.addCons(x[0] + x[1] + x[2] + x[3] >= req[0], "month1")

# Month 3: types 3,4 cover it
m.addCons(x[2] + x[3] >= req[2], "month3")
# Month 4: only type 4 covers it

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
months = [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]
n = 6
buy_price = [28, 24, 25, 27, 23, 23]
sell_price = [29, 24, 26, 28, 22, 25]
initial_stock = 200
max_capacity = 500

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = [m.addVar(name=f"x_{months[t]}", lb=0, vtype="C") for t in range(n)]  # purchases
s = [m.addVar(name=f"s_{months[t]}", lb=0, vtype="C") for t in range(n)]  # sales
I = [m.addVar(name=f"I_{months[t]}", lb=0, ub=max_capacity, vtype="C") for t in range(n)]  # end-of-month inventory

# Inventory balance constraints
m.addCons(I[0] == initial_stock + x[0] - s[0], "inv_0")
for t in range(1, n):

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
requirements = [10, 15, 25, 20, 18, 12]  # periods 1-6: 2-6, 6-10, 10-14, 14-18, 18-22, 22-2
shift_starts = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  # indices for 6 shift start times
n_periods = 6
cost_regular = 10 * 8  # 80 yuan per 8-hour shift
cost_contract = 15 * 8  # 120 yuan per 8-hour shift

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: R[i] = regular nurses starting at shift i, C[i] = contract nurses starting at shift i
R = [m.addVar(v=f"R_{i}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="I") for i in range(n_periods)]
C = [m.addVar(v=f"C_{i}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="I") for i in range(n_periods)]

# Coverage constraints: nurse starting at shift i covers periods i and (i+1)%6
# Period p is covered by nurses starting at shift p and shift (p-1)%6
for p in range(n_periods):
    prev = (p - 1) % n_periods
    m.addCons(R[prev] + C[prev] + R[p] + C[p] >= requirements[p], name=f"cover_{p}")

# Objective: minimize total cost
obj = quicksum(cost_regular * R[i] for i in range(n_periods)) + quicksum(cost_contract * C[i] for i in range(n_periods))
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    print("Regular nurses per shift start (2,6,10,14,18,22):", [m.getVal(R[i]) for i in range(n_periods)])
    print("Contract nurses per shift start (2,6,10,14,18,22):", [m.getVal(C[i]) for i in range(n_periods)])
    total_regular = sum(m.getVal(R[i]) for i in range(n_periods))
    total_contract = sum(m.getVal(C[i]) for i in range(n_periods))
    print(f"Total regular: {total_regular}, Total contract: {total_contract}")

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()

x = [m.addVar(name=f"x_{t}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C") for t in range(3)]
s = [m.addVar(name=f"s_{t}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C") for t in range(3)]

# Selling constraints:
# Month 1: can only sell initial stock
m.addCons(s[0] <= initial_stock, "sell_m1")
# Month 2: can only sell grain purchased in month 1
m.addCons(s[1] <= x[0], "sell_m2")
# Month 3: can only sell grain purchased in month 2
m.addCons(s[2] <= x[1], "sell_m3")

# Warehouse capacity constraints (end of each month)
# End of month 1: initial_stock - s_1 + x_1 <= capacity
m.addCons(initial_stock - s[0] + x[0] <= capacity, "cap_m1")
# End of month 2: initial_stock - s_1 + x_1 - s_2 + x_2 <= capacity
m.addCons(initial_stock - s[0] + x[0] - s[1] + x[1] <= capacity, "cap_m2")
# End of month 3: initial_stock - s_1 + x_1 - s_2 + x_2 - s_3 + x_3 <= capacity
m.addCons(initial_stock - s[0] + x[0] - s[1] + x[1] - s[2] + x[2] <= capacity, "cap_m3")

m.addCons(initial_stock - s[0] + x[0] - s[1] + x[1] - s[2] + x[2] == end_inventory, "end_inv")

m.addCons(initial_funds + sell_price[0]*s[0] - buy_price[0]*x[0] >= 0, "funds_m1")

           + sell_price[1]*s[1] - buy_price[1]*x[1] >= 0, "funds_m2")

                used = 0.5 * a + 0.7 * b + 0.9 * c
                if used <= sw + 1e-9:
                    if a + b + c > 0:  # skip empty pattern
                        waste_width = sw - used
                        patterns.append((a, b, c, sw, waste_width))

m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x[i] = length (meters) of pattern i

x_p = m.addVar("x_p", lb=0, vtype="C")  # acres of pears
x_o = m.addVar("x_o", lb=0, vtype="C")  # acres of oranges
x_l = m.addVar("x_l", lb=0, vtype="C")  # acres of lemons

# Binary variables: whether each fruit type is grown
y_a = m.addVar("y_a", vtype="B")
y_p = m.addVar("y_p", vtype="B")
y_o = m.addVar("y_o", vtype="B")
y_l = m.addVar("y_l", vtype="B")

# Objective: maximize total profit
m.setObjective(2000 * x_a + 1800 * x_p + 2200 * x_o + 3000 * x_l, "maximize")

# Total land constraint: sum of all acres <= 120
m.addCons(x_a + x_p + x_o + x_l <= 120, "total_land")

m.addCons(x_a >= 2 * x_p, "apples_ge_2_pears")

m.addCons(x_a >= 3 * x_l, "apples_ge_3_lemons")

m.addCons(x_o == 2 * x_l, "oranges_eq_2_lemons")

m.addCons(y_a + y_p + y_o + y_l <= 2, "max_two_fruits")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
raw_costs = {'A': 2.00, 'B': 1.50, 'C': 1.00}
raw_limits = {'A': 2000, 'B': 2500, 'C': 1200}
processing_fees = {'A': 0.50, 'B': 0.40, 'C': 0.30}
selling_prices = {'A': 3.40, 'B': 2.85, 'C': 2.25}

# Composition constraints (percentage of raw material i in brand j)
# Row A: brand A >= 60%, brand B >= 15%, brand C: none
# Row B: no constraints
# Row C: brand A <= 20%, brand B <= 60%, brand C <= 50%

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x[i][j] = kg of raw material i used in brand j
raws = ['A', 'B', 'C']
brands = ['A', 'B', 'C']
x = {}
for i in raws:
    for j in brands:
        x[i][j] = m.addVar(name=f"x_{i}_{j}", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")

# Total production of each brand
T = {}
for j in brands:
    T[j] = quicksum(x[i][j] for i in raws)

# Objective: maximize profit = revenue - raw cost - processing cost
obj = quicksum(
    selling_prices[j] * T[j] - processing_fees[j] * T[j] for j in brands
) - quicksum(
    raw_costs[i] * x[i][j] for i in raws for j in brands
)
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

# Raw material availability constraints
for i in raws:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i][j] for j in brands) <= raw_limits[i], name=f"limit_{i}")

# Composition constraints
# Brand A: raw A >= 60% of total
m.addCons(x['A']['A'] >= 0.60 * T['A'], name="comp_A_brandA")
# Brand A: raw C <= 20% of total
m.addCons(x['C']['A'] <= 0.20 * T['A'], name="comp_C_brandA")
# Brand B: raw A >= 15% of total
m.addCons(x['A']['B'] >= 0.15 * T['B'], name="comp_A_brandB")
# Brand B: raw C <= 60% of total
m.addCons(x['C']['B'] <= 0.60 * T['B'], name="comp_C_brandB")
# Brand C: raw C <= 50% of total
m.addCons(x['C']['C'] <= 0.50 * T['C'], name="comp_C_brandC")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for j in brands:
        print(f"Brand {j} total: {sum(m.getVal(x[i][j]) for i in raws):.2f} kg")
        for i in raws:
            print(f"  raw {i}: {m.getVal(x[i][j]):.2f} kg")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
devices = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']
prep_cost = {'A': 1000, 'B': 920, 'C': 800, 'D': 700}
unit_cost = {'A': 20, 'B': 24, 'C': 16, 'D': 28}
capacity  = {'A': 900, 'B': 1000, 'C': 1200, 'D': 1600}
demand = 2000

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = {}
y = {}
for d in devices:
    x[d] = m.addVar(name=f"x_{d}", lb=0, ub=capacity[d], vtype="C")
    y[d] = m.addVar(name=f"y_{d}", lb=0, ub=1, vtype="B")

# Constraints
# Total production equals demand
m.addCons(quicksum(x[d] for d in devices) == demand, name="demand")

# Link production to device activation
for d in devices:
    m.addCons(x[d] <= capacity[d] * y[d], name=f"cap_{d}")

# Objective: minimize total cost
obj = quicksum(prep_cost[d] * y[d] + unit_cost[d] * x[d] for d in devices)
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for d in devices:
        print(f"  Device {d}: enabled={m.getVal(y[d]):.0f}, units={m.getVal(x[d]):.2f}")

bicycle_pollution = 0

m.hideOutput()

x_b = m.addVar(name="x_b", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=m.infinity())
x_c = m.addVar(name="x_c", vtype="I", lb=0, ub=m.infinity())

y_c = m.addVar(name="y_c", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)

m.addCons(x_c <= M_big * y_c, "link_c")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
candidates = ['F', 'G', 'H', 'I', 'J']
salaries = {'F': 12000, 'G': 15000, 'H': 18000, 'I': 5000, 'J': 10000}
skill_levels = {'F': 2, 'G': 3, 'H': 4, 'I': 1, 'J': 2}
pm_experience = {'F': 1, 'G': 2, 'H': 2, 'I': 5, 'J': 4}
budget = 40000
max_employees = 4
min_skill = 8
min_pm = 8
conflict_pairs = [('G', 'J')]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: binary
x = {}
for c in candidates:
    x[c] = m.addVar(name=f"x_{c}", vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)

# Objective: minimize total salary
m.setObjective(quicksum(salaries[c] * x[c] for c in candidates), "minimize")

# Constraint 1: Budget
m.addCons(quicksum(salaries[c] * x[c] for c in candidates) <= budget, name="budget")

# Constraint 2: Max 4 employees
m.addCons(quicksum(x[c] for c in candidates) <= max_employees, name="max_employees")

# Constraint 3: Total skill level >= 8
m.addCons(quicksum(skill_levels[c] * x[c] for c in candidates) >= min_skill, name="min_skill")

# Constraint 4: Total PM experience >= 8
m.addCons(quicksum(pm_experience[c] * x[c] for c in candidates) >= min_pm, name="min_pm")

# Constraint 5: At most one of G and J
for a, b in conflict_pairs:
    m.addCons(x[a] + x[b] <= 1, name=f"conflict_{a}_{b}")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

# Decision variables: monthly production (continuous)
x1 = m.addVar(name="microwave", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
x2 = m.addVar(name="water_heater", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")

# Objective: minimize total monthly cost
# Workshop A: 80 yuan/hr * (2*x1 + 1*x2)
# Workshop B: 20 yuan/hr * (1*x1 + 3*x2)
# Inspection/sales: 30*x1 + 50*x2
m.setObjective(80*(2*x1 + x2) + 20*(x1 + 3*x2) + 30*x1 + 50*x2, "minimize")

# Constraint 1: Inspection and sales costs <= 5500
m.addCons(30*x1 + 50*x2 <= 5500, name="insp_sales_budget")

# Constraint 2: At least 80 microwave ovens
m.addCons(x1 >= 80, name="min_microwave")

# Constraint 3: Workshop hours fully utilized (capacity upper bounds)
# Workshop A: 250 regular + 20 overtime max = 270
m.addCons(2*x1 + x2 <= 270, name="workshop_A_capacity")
# Workshop B: 150 (no overtime mentioned)
m.addCons(x1 + 3*x2 <= 150, name="workshop_B_capacity")

# Constraint 4: Overtime in A <= 20 (already embedded in A capacity = 270)
# Explicitly: 2*x1 + x2 - 250 <= 20  (same as above, kept for clarity)

m.addCons(x2 >= 50, name="min_water_heater")

        print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
        print(f"microwave: {m.getVal(x1)}")

for c in children:
    x[c] = m.addVar(name=c, vtype="B", lb=0, ub=1)

m.setObjective(quicksum(cost[c] * x[c] for c in children), "minimize")

m.addCons(quicksum(x[c] for c in children) <= max_children, "max_children")

m.addCons(x["Bob"] == 1, "bob_must_go")

m.addCons(x["Alice"] + x["Diana"] <= 1, "alice_not_diana")

m.addCons(x["Bob"] + x["Charlie"] <= 1, "bob_not_charlie")

m.addCons(x["Charlie"] <= x["Diana"], "charlie_implies_diana")

m.addCons(x["Diana"] <= x["Ella"], "diana_implies_ella")

m.addCons(quicksum(x[c] for c in children) >= min_children, "min_children")

    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for c in children:

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Data (units: 10,000 m³ for volume, 10,000 yuan for money)
purchase_price = [410, 430, 460, 450]   # 10,000 yuan / 10,000 m³
sale_price = [425, 440, 465, 455]       # 10,000 yuan / 10,000 m³
max_sales = [100, 140, 200, 160]        # 10,000 m³
capacity = 200                          # 10,000 m³ (200,000 m³)
a = 70
b = 100
n = 4  # quarters: 0=Winter, 1=Spring, 2=Summer, 3=Autumn

# Decision variables: x[i,j] = volume bought in quarter i and sold in quarter j (i <= j)
x = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i, n):
        x[i, j] = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name=f"x_{i}_{j}")

# Storage cost for holding from quarter i to quarter j (u = j - i quarters)
def storage_cost(i, j):
    if i == j:
        return 0
    u = j - i
    return a + b * u

# Objective: maximize total profit = sum (sale - purchase - storage) * x[i,j]
profit_terms = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i, n):
        coeff = sale_price[j] - purchase_price[i] - storage_cost(i, j)
        profit_terms.append(coeff * x[i, j])

m.setObjective(quicksum(profit_terms), "maximize")

# Sales constraint: total sold in quarter j <= max_sales[j]
for j in range(n):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(j + 1)) <= max_sales[j], name=f"sales_{j}")

# Warehouse capacity: at end of quarter t, inventory (bought <=t, sold >t) <= capacity
for t in range(n - 1):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(t + 1) for j in range(t + 1, n)) <= capacity, name=f"cap_{t}")

# All inventory must be sold by end of autumn (automatically satisfied: j max is 3=Autumn)

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

    'C': [20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110],
}
setup = {'A': 100, 'B': 135, 'C': 200}
n_parts = 10
machines = ['A', 'B', 'C']

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# x[i][j] = 1 if part i is processed on machine j
x = {}
for i in range(n_parts):
    for j in machines:
        x[i, j] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{i}_{j}")

# y[j] = 1 if machine j is used
y = {}
for j in machines:
    y[j] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"y_{j}")

# Objective: minimize total processing cost + setup cost
obj = quicksum(costs[j][i] * x[i, j] for i in range(n_parts) for j in machines) + \
      quicksum(setup[j] * y[j] for j in machines)
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

# Constraint 1: each part processed on exactly one machine
for i in range(n_parts):
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, j] for j in machines) == 1, name=f"assign_part_{i}")

# Linking constraints: y[j] >= x[i][j] for all i, j
for i in range(n_parts):
    for j in machines:
        m.addCons(y[j] >= x[i, j], name=f"link_{i}_{j}")

import json

# Data transcribed from problem
n_full = 5
n_part = 4
hours_full = 160
hours_part = 80
rate_full = 5      # pairs/hour for full-time
rate_part = 2      # pairs/hour for part-time
wage_full = 1.0
wage_part = 0.6
ot_wage_full = 1.5
ot_wage_part = 0.7
profit_per_pair = 0.3
target_sales = 5500

max_reg_full = n_full * hours_full   # 800
max_reg_part = n_part * hours_part   # 320

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x1 = m.addVar("x1", lb=0, ub=max_reg_full, vtype="C")  # regular hours, full-time
x2 = m.addVar("x2", lb=0, ub=max_reg_part, vtype="C")  # regular hours, part-time
x3 = m.addVar("x3", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")  # overtime hours, full-time
x4 = m.addVar("x4", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")  # overtime hours, part-time

# Deviation variables
d1m = m.addVar("d1m", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d1p = m.addVar("d1p", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d2m = m.addVar("d2m", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d2p = m.addVar("d2p", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d3m = m.addVar("d3m", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d3p = m.addVar("d3p", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d4m = m.addVar("d4m", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")
d4p = m.addVar("d4p", lb=0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")

# Goal 1: achieve 5500 pairs monthly sales
m.addCons(rate_full * x1 + rate_full * x3 + rate_part * x2 + rate_part * x4 + d1m - d1p == target_sales, "goal1")

# Goal 2: full employment of all clerks
m.addCons(x1 + d2m - d2p == max_reg_full, "goal2_full")
m.addCons(x2 + d3m - d3p == max_reg_part, "goal2_part")

# Goal 3: minimize overtime hours
m.addCons(x3 + x4 + d4m - d4p == 0, "goal3")

# Lexicographic objective via large weights
P1 = 10000
P2 = 100
P3 = 1

obj = P1 * d1m + P2 * (d2m + d3m) + P3 * d4m
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Data
task1_hours = 8400
task2_hours = 10800
task3_hours = 18000
wage_skilled = 100
wage_laborer = 80
hours_skilled = 42
hours_laborer = 36
setup_cost_1B = 500
max_skilled = 400
max_laborer = 800
min_skilled_3B = 20

# Binary variables: method selection
x1A = m.addVar("x1A", vtype="B")
x1B = m.addVar("x1B", vtype="B")
x2A = m.addVar("x2A", vtype="B")
x2B = m.addVar("x2B", vtype="B")
x3A = m.addVar("x3A", vtype="B")
x3B = m.addVar("x3B", vtype="B")

# Integer variables: workers assigned to each task
s1 = m.addVar("s1", vtype="I", lb=0)
l1 = m.addVar("l1", vtype="I", lb=0)
s2 = m.addVar("s2", vtype="I", lb=0)
l2 = m.addVar("l2", vtype="I", lb=0)
s3 = m.addVar("s3", vtype="I", lb=0)
l3 = m.addVar("l3", vtype="I", lb=0)

# Auxiliary variables for linearizing products of integer and binary vars
w1 = m.addVar("w1", vtype="I", lb=0)  # w1 = s1 * x1B
w3 = m.addVar("w3", vtype="I", lb=0)  # w3 = s3 * x3B

# Method selection: exactly one method per task
m.addCons(x1A + x1B == 1, "method_task1")
m.addCons(x2A + x2B == 1, "method_task2")
m.addCons(x3A + x3B == 1, "method_task3")

# Task 1: Method A (skilled only) or Method B (1 skilled + 2 laborers)
m.addCons(hours_skilled * s1 + hours_laborer * l1 >= task1_hours, "task1_hours")
m.addCons(l1 <= 400 * x1B, "task1_l1_zero_if_A")
m.addCons(l1 >= 2 * w1, "task1_ratio_lower")
S1_MAX = 400
m.addCons(w1 <= s1, "w1_le_s1")
m.addCons(w1 <= S1_MAX * x1B, "w1_le_max")
m.addCons(w1 >= s1 - S1_MAX * (1 - x1B), "w1_ge_s1")

# Task 2: Method A (skilled only) or Method B (laborers only)
m.addCons(hours_skilled * s2 + hours_laborer * l2 >= task2_hours, "task2_hours")
m.addCons(s2 <= 258 * x2A, "task2_s2_zero_if_B")
m.addCons(l2 <= 300 * x2B, "task2_l2_zero_if_A")

# Task 3: Method A (laborers only) or Method B (1 skilled + 3 laborers)
m.addCons(hours_skilled * s3 + hours_laborer * l3 >= task3_hours, "task3_hours")
m.addCons(s3 <= 120 * x3B, "task3_s3_zero_if_A")
L3_MAX = 800
m.addCons(l3 <= 3 * w3 + L3_MAX * x3A, "task3_l3_upper")
m.addCons(l3 >= 3 * w3, "task3_l3_lower")
S3_MAX = 120
m.addCons(w3 <= s3, "w3_le_s3")
m.addCons(w3 <= S3_MAX * x3B, "w3_le_max")
m.addCons(w3 >= s3 - S3_MAX * (1 - x3B), "w3_ge_s3")

# Exclusion rule: if Task1 uses Method B, Task3 cannot use Method A
m.addCons(x1B + x3A <= 1, "exclusion_rule")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data: car lengths in meters
lam = [4, 4.5, 5, 4.1, 2.4, 5.2, 3.7, 3.5, 3.2, 4.5, 2.3, 3.3, 3.8, 4.6, 3]
n = len(lam)
total_len = sum(lam)  # 57.1
max_side = 30  # per-side limit from the second part of the problem

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x_i = 1 if car i is parked on side 1, 0 if on side 2
x = [m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{i}") for i in range(n)]

# z = total length of street occupied = max(side1_sum, side2_sum)
z = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name="z")

# Objective: minimize total street length occupied
m.setObjective(z, "minimize")

# z >= total length on side 1
m.addCons(z >= quicksum(lam[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)), "side1_len")

# z >= total length on side 2
m.addCons(z >= quicksum(lam[i] * (1 - x[i]) for i in range(n)), "side2_len")

# Per-side limit: each side cannot exceed 30 meters
m.addCons(quicksum(lam[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= max_side, "side1_limit")
m.addCons(quicksum(lam[i] * (1 - x[i]) for i in range(n)) <= max_side, "side2_limit")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for i in range(n):
        side = 1 if m.getVal(x[i]) > 0.5 else 2
        print(f"  car {i+1} (len {lam[i]}m) -> side {side}")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data: minimum waiters needed per 4-hour period
# Periods: 1:2-6, 2:6-10, 3:10-14, 4:14-18, 5:18-22, 6:22-2
min_waiters = [4, 8, 10, 7, 12, 4]
n_periods = 6

m = Model("waiter_scheduling")
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables: x[i] = number of waiters starting at period i (i=0..5)
x = [m.addVar(name=f"x_{i}", lb=0, vtype="I") for i in range(n_periods)]

# Objective: minimize total waiters
m.setObjective(quicksum(x), "minimize")

# Constraints: for each period, the waiters covering it must meet the minimum
# A waiter starting at period i covers period i and period (i+1) % 6
for i in range(n_periods):
    # Period i is covered by waiters starting at i and at (i-1) % 6
    covering = x[i] + x[(i - 1) % n_periods]
    m.addCons(covering >= min_waiters[i], name=f"cover_period_{i}")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for i in range(n_periods):
        print(f"  x_{i} (start at period {i+1}): {m.getVal(x[i])}")

machine_time_Y = 19      # minutes per batch of Y

craft_time_Y = 29        # minutes per batch of Y

craft_avail = 35 * 60    # 35 hours in minutes = 2100

profit_X = rev_X - (machine_time_X * cost_machine_per_hr + craft_time_X * cost_craft_per_hr) / 60.0
profit_Y = rev_Y - (machine_time_Y * cost_machine_per_hr + craft_time_Y * cost_craft_per_hr) / 60.0

m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

y = m.addVar(name="y", lb=0.0, ub=m.infinity(), vtype="C")

m.addCons(machine_time_X * x + machine_time_Y * y <= machine_avail, "machine_time")

m.addCons(craft_time_X * x + craft_time_Y * y <= craft_avail, "craft_time")

m.addCons(x >= min_X, "contract_X")

m.addCons(storage_factor_A * x_A + storage_factor_B * x_B <= storage_capacity, name="storage")

m.addCons(time_A * xA + time_B * xB <= machine_time, name="machine_time")

m.addCons(ratio_B * xA - ratio_A * xB <= 0, name="ratio_constraint")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    print(f"x_A = {m.getVal(xA)}")

]
price = [20, 30, 40]

budget = 150
weight_limit = 20
n_comp = 3
max_spares = 5

# Binary variables: y[i][s] = 1 if component i has s spares
y = {}
for i in range(n_comp):
    for s in range(max_spares + 1):
        y[i, s] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"y_{i}_{s}")

# Each component gets exactly one spare count
for i in range(n_comp):
    m.addCons(quicksum(y[i, s] for s in range(max_spares + 1)) == 1, name=f"exactly_one_{i}")

m.addCons(quicksum(s * price[i] * y[i, s] for i in range(n_comp) for s in range(max_spares + 1)) <= budget, name="budget")

m.addCons(quicksum(s * weight[i] * y[i, s] for i in range(n_comp) for s in range(max_spares + 1)) <= weight_limit, name="weight")

# Objective: maximize product of component reliabilities
R_exprs = []
for i in range(n_comp):
    R_exprs.append(quicksum(R[i][s] * y[i, s] for s in range(max_spares + 1)))

obj = R_exprs[0] * R_exprs[1] * R_exprs[2]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()

# Data

    [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0],
    [0.6, 0.75, 0.95, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
    [0.7, 0.9, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
]
price = [20, 30, 40]
weight = [2, 4, 6]
budget = 150
weight_limit = 20
max_spares = 5

# Binary variable x[s1,s2,s3] = 1 if comp1 has s1 spares, comp2 has s2, comp3 has s3
x = {}
for s1 in range(max_spares + 1):
    for s2 in range(max_spares + 1):
        for s3 in range(max_spares + 1):
            x[s1, s2, s3] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{s1}_{s2}_{s3}")

# Exactly one combination is selected
m.addCons(quicksum(x[s1, s2, s3] for s1 in range(max_spares + 1) for s2 in range(max_spares + 1) for s3 in range(max_spares + 1)) == 1, name="exactly_one")

# Budget constraint
m.addCons(quicksum((s1 * price[0] + s2 * price[1] + s3 * price[2]) * x[s1, s2, s3]
                   for s1 in range(max_spares + 1) for s2 in range(max_spares + 1) for s3 in range(max_spares + 1)) <= budget, name="budget")

# Weight constraint
m.addCons(quicksum((s1 * weight[0] + s2 * weight[1] + s3 * weight[2]) * x[s1, s2, s3]
                   for s1 in range(max_spares + 1) for s2 in range(max_spares + 1) for s3 in range(max_spares + 1)) <= weight_limit, name="weight")

# Objective: maximize product of reliabilities (linear in x)
obj = quicksum(R[0][s1] * R[1][s2] * R[2][s3] * x[s1, s2, s3]
               for s1 in range(max_spares + 1) for s2 in range(max_spares + 1) for s3 in range(max_spares + 1))
m.setObjective(obj, "maximize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
    for s1 in range(max_spares + 1):
        for s2 in range(max_spares + 1):
            for s3 in range(max_spares + 1):
                if m.getVal(x[s1, s2, s3]) > 0.5:
                    print(f"Component 1: {s1} spares, reliability = {R[0][s1]}")
                    print(f"Component 2: {s2} spares, reliability = {R[1][s2]}")
                    print(f"Component 3: {s3} spares, reliability = {R[2][s3]}")
                    print(f"Total cost: {s1*price[0]+s2*price[1]+s3*price[2]} yuan")
                    print(f"Total weight: {s1*weight[0]+s2*weight[1]+s3*weight[2]} kg")

from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum

# Data
nodes = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']
n = len(nodes)
idx = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(nodes)}
A, Bn, C, D, E = idx['A'], idx['B'], idx['C'], idx['D'], idx['E']

# Bandwidth matrix: bw[i][j] = bandwidth from node i to node j
bw = [
    [0, 90, 85, 0, 65],   # from A
    [95, 0, 70, 65, 34],  # from B
    [60, 0, 0, 88, 80],   # from C
    [67, 30, 25, 0, 84],  # from D
    [0, 51, 0, 56, 0],    # from E
]

# Directed edges with positive bandwidth
edges = [(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if bw[i][j] > 0]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = {}
for (i, j) in edges:
    x[i, j] = m.addVar(vtype="B", name=f"x_{nodes[i]}_{nodes[j]}")

# Bvar = minimum bandwidth on the chosen path
Bvar = m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name="Bvar")

# --- Constraints ---

# No incoming edges to A, no outgoing edges from E
for i in range(n):
    if i != A and (i, A) in x:
        m.addCons(x[i, A] == 0)
for j in range(n):
    if j != E and (E, j) in x:
        m.addCons(x[E, j] == 0)

# A: exactly one outgoing edge (path starts at A)
m.addCons(quicksum(x[A, j] for (i, j) in edges if i == A) == 1)

# E: exactly one incoming edge (path ends at E)
m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, E] for (i, j) in edges if j == E) == 1)

# C: must be on the path (exactly one in, one out)
m.addCons(quicksum(x[i, C] for (i, j) in edges if j == C) == 1)
m.addCons(quicksum(x[C, j] for (i, j) in edges if i == C) == 1)

# B and D: flow conservation (in = out) and at most one visit (no loops)
for node in [Bn, D]:
    m.addCons(
        quicksum(x[i, node] for (i, j) in edges if j == node) ==
        quicksum(x[node, j] for (i, j) in edges if i == node)
    )
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[node, j] for (i, j) in edges if i == node) <= 1)

# Bandwidth: Bvar <= bw[i][j] for every edge selected in the path
M = max(bw[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
for (i, j) in edges:
    m.addCons(Bvar <= bw[i][j] + M * (1 - x[i, j]))

# Objective: maximize the link bandwidth
m.setObjective(Bvar, "maximize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")
